world.title: Indian Passport Climbs To 84th Rank, But Visa-Free Access Falls. Check Latest List
world.summary: India's passport has risen to 84th place in the latest Henley Passport Index, up from 85th in October 2025. Indian passport holders can now access 55 destinations without prior visa requirements. The current ranking places India alongside Algeria and Mauritania. The updated list reflects changes in visa-free access, highlighting a slight improvement in India's global passport standing.

world.title: US 'expects' Jaishankar to meet Rubio in Mumbai? Cong questions govt's silence over Sergio Gor's remark
world.summary: The Congress party criticized the Indian government for its lack of response regarding US Secretary of State Marco Rubio's anticipated visit to India. They specifically highlighted concerns over US Ambassador Sergio Gor's comments that US officials "expect" External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar to meet Rubio. The Congress seeks clarification on the government's stance regarding this diplomatic engagement.

world.title: Using light to control brain cells
world.summary: The 2026 Nobel Prize in physiology or medicine was awarded to Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann, and Georg Nagel for their contributions to optogenetics. This innovative technique, derived from an algae gene, enables researchers to manipulate neuron activity using light. It holds potential for advancing treatments for various eye disorders and neuropsychiatric conditions, enhancing our understanding of brain functions.

business.title: Tech Mahindra Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 33% YoY to Rs 1,586 crore; co declares Rs 15/share dividend, 1:1 bonus issue
business.summary: Tech Mahindra reported a 33% year-on-year increase in net profit for Q2, reaching Rs 1,586 crore. The company's board declared an interim dividend of Rs 15 per equity share, representing 300% for the financial year 2026-27. Additionally, a 1:1 bonus issue was approved, allowing shareholders to receive one bonus share for each existing share held, subject to conditions.

business.title: CADRE ODR appoints Jonathan Rodrigues as Head of Mediation Services
business.summary: CADRE ODR has appointed Jonathan Rodrigues as Head of Mediation Services. Rodrigues emphasized the need for sustainable mediation practices, stating that while the concept is popular, effective implementation remains a challenge. He expressed confidence in the current opportunity to enhance mediation services at CADRE ODR, aiming to develop strategies that will make mediation a viable option for conflict resolution.

business.title: Jio Platforms heading towards becoming net debt-free after Rs 30,213 crore IPO, says Akash Ambani
business.summary: Jio Platforms is on track to become net debt-free, according to Akash Ambani. The company plans to utilize funds from its Rs 30,213-crore initial public offering (IPO) to repay existing borrowings and enhance its financial standing. This strategic move aims to strengthen the company's balance sheet and improve its overall financial health in the market.

technology.title: OLED, Mini LED, or QLED? The Ultimate 2026 TV buying guide for gamers, sports fans, and bright rooms
technology.summary: Choosing the right TV technology—OLED, Mini LED, or QLED—depends on room conditions, viewing habits, and budget. OLED offers deep blacks and cinematic visuals, making it ideal for dark environments. Mini LED provides high brightness and strong contrast for well-lit rooms, while QLED delivers vivid colors and a range of price options, catering to various consumer preferences.

technology.title: Oppo Pad Mini and Enco X4 to launch in India with Find X10 series on Oct 22, details here
technology.summary: Oppo will launch the Pad Mini Matte Display Edition tablet and Enco X4 true wireless stereo earphones in India on October 22. These devices feature a matte OLED display, premium audio capabilities, and AI-powered functionalities. The launch will coincide with the introduction of the flagship Oppo Find X10 smartphone series, marking a significant event for the company.

technology.title: Turning rising gut health expectations into better wellness products
technology.summary: Gut health has evolved from a clinical focus to a mainstream topic, influencing consumer behavior and product development. The rise of "fibremaxxing" reflects growing expectations for wellness products that support gut health. This shift is evident in social media discussions, supermarket offerings, and the language used by shoppers, highlighting the increasing importance of gut health in everyday life.

sports.title: England women's A squad will play red-ball cricket in India to continue Ashes preparation
sports.summary: England women's A squad will tour India in November and December as part of their preparation for the upcoming Women's Ashes. The tour includes three T20 matches, three 50-over fixtures, and a four-day red-ball game. This initiative aims to enhance the team's performance and readiness for the Ashes series scheduled for the following summer.

sports.title: Sydney Thunder sign Boult for entire BBL 2026-27 season
sports.summary: Sydney Thunder have signed New Zealand fast bowler Trent Boult for the entire BBL 2026-27 season. In related news, Bangladesh legspinner Rishad Hossain will return to the Hobart Hurricanes for a second consecutive season. The announcements highlight team strategies as they prepare for the upcoming Big Bash League season, aiming to strengthen their rosters with experienced players.

sports.title: "Can No Longer Complain About Financial Support": Ministry Grills Federations In Asiad Review
sports.summary: India's Sports Ministry reviewed the country's performance at the Asian Games, focusing on the disappointing medal tally in key sports such as athletics and badminton. Concerns were raised regarding the impact of injuries on athletes and the adequacy of financial support provided to federations. The ministry emphasized that federations can no longer complain about funding amidst these challenges.

health.title: Could Ozempic Protect The Brain? Study Finds Links To Lower Stroke And Alzheimer’s Risk
health.summary: A study has found potential links between GLP-1 receptor agonists, including Ozempic, and improved brain health. Researchers discovered genetic evidence suggesting that these medications may lower the risk of stroke and Alzheimer’s disease. Originally developed for diabetes management and weight loss, Ozempic is now being investigated for its possible neuroprotective effects, highlighting its broader implications for health.

health.title: Childhood pneumonia: A preventable disease that still takes too many young lives
health.summary: Pneumonia is frequently underestimated, often dismissed as a minor illness until severe symptoms arise. It is a significant preventable cause of childhood mortality, highlighting deficiencies in nutrition, immunization, air quality, sanitation, and access to healthcare. Recent global estimates indicate that lower respiratory infections, including pneumonia, continue to pose a serious threat to children's health worldwide.

health.title: Long Commutes, Bumpy Roads and Screen Time Adding to Back and Neck Pain, Warn CARE Hospitals Doctors
health.summary: On World Spine Day, doctors from CARE Hospitals in Hyderabad warned that long commutes, poor posture, and laptop use contribute to back and neck pain. They highlighted that prolonged sitting and jolts from pothole-ridden roads can exacerbate existing spinal issues. The emphasis is on the need for awareness regarding these factors affecting spinal health among commuters.

science.title: I finally found a better way to save things from the internet
science.summary: Self-hosting a free reader has transformed a collection of unused bookmarks into an organized and visually appealing library. This new system enhances workflow by allowing easy access to saved content. The author, who previously struggled to revisit bookmarks, now enjoys a streamlined read-it-later experience, ensuring that important information is categorized and readily available for future reference.

science.title: NASA's Chandra explains Treble Clef galaxy collision
science.summary: Astronomers have identified the source of a unique radio structure resembling a treble clef, linked to an ancient black hole outburst and the collision of two galaxy clusters. This discovery was made using NASA's Chandra X-ray Observatory alongside other telescopes. The findings enhance understanding of cosmic events and the interactions between black holes and galaxy clusters.

science.title: How to Build an AI Bioinformatics Career
science.summary: Building a career in AI bioinformatics requires proficiency in biology, programming languages like Python and R, Linux, next-generation sequencing (NGS), and machine learning. Gaining practical experience through projects and internships is essential. The integration of computational methods in biological research has increased significantly, driven by the growing complexity of biological datasets, making this field increasingly relevant.

entertainment.title: Nushrratt Bharuccha discharged from hospital after successful spine surgery due to accident in Bali, official statement says ‘She remains positive and is focusing on healing and regaining her strength
entertainment.summary: Nushrratt Bharuccha has been discharged from the hospital after successful spine surgery due to an accident in Bali. An official statement confirmed her positive outlook as she focuses on healing and regaining strength. The actress had been receiving medical care for her injury and is now back home, beginning her recovery process following the surgery.

entertainment.title: Nushrratt Bharuccha undergoes successful spine surgery after Bali accident, returns home to recover: ‘Relieved to share that the surgery went well’
entertainment.summary: Actor Nushrratt Bharuccha has successfully undergone spine surgery after an accident in Bali. Her team announced that she has been discharged from the hospital and is now at home, concentrating on her recovery. Bharuccha expressed relief over the successful outcome of the surgery, indicating a positive step forward in her health journey following the incident.

entertainment.title: WWE Crown Jewel at Risk as Saudi Arabia Considers Cancelling Riyadh Season
entertainment.summary: WWE Crown Jewel faces uncertainty as Saudi Arabia contemplates canceling all Riyadh Season events for the remainder of the year. This decision could significantly impact the scheduled wrestling event, which is typically part of the Riyadh Season festivities. The situation remains fluid, with potential implications for WWE's plans and operations in the region, depending on Saudi Arabia's final decision.
